findings.requirement: Terminal child task execution after join
findings.remaining_boundary: ScopedOwnedTasksV1 covers original and worker-fresh Buffer results, worker failure cleanup, handler rethrow, completed-child custody and distinct generations on address reuse, with bounded Linux native evidence. These are model-level regressions over trusted explicit traces and a checked finite task IR: they establish no source-to-trace refinement. Checked mutex invariants now exist as a separate model profile (R03) but are not composed with the task ledger. Per T00, the mapped CT cases' manifest stage labels exceed their executed evidence and no mapped case carries proof or gated sanitized evidence. Loans, fractional shares, general owned graphs and error payloads, nested workers, general control flow, arbitrary native schedules and Rust/Lean/native refinement remain open.

findings.requirement: Explicit mutex and synchronization trust boundary
findings.remaining_boundary: The checked profile discharges GuardFootprintAuthority and SynchronizedCustodyEdges only inside CheckedMutexInvariantV1, over supplied traces. TrustedExplicitTrace still issues both premises and is unchanged. The new profile introduces two narrower premises of its own (DeclaredFootprintShape, InvariantPredicateDeclared), and the pointwise-atom refinement of the abstract authority total is a premise, not a theorem. No source lowering (T03), no deadlock freedom, no lock-order analysis, no condition variables/rwlocks/try-locks, no composition with the scoped-task ledger, no CT mapping, no promotion.

Nonzero-net positive maximum counts reject. Exact counts remain supplied premises; the summary API carries no allocation-identity discharge, and scalar ledger balance is not an identity discharge. No source loop is admitted, so no source program reaches this vocabulary. Identity alternatives and arbitrary nonzero-net upper-bound inference remain unimplemented.

Full i32/i128 literal extrema are checked in every reachable signed route; arbitrary expression and result semantics are not added. Constant arithmetic exists only in the observation route and stays range-checked there. Route (a3) has probe-only coverage and its accepted range was value-checked only at the minimum and zero. No parser/Rust/C refinement proof is claimed.

findings.requirement: Current specification, commands and diagnostic ownership
findings.remaining_boundary: The spec's Q7xx row was stale and is corrected to the four codes the code emits; AGENTS.md was already accurate. The Q020 (task route) / Q021 (sequential route) split for an unenforced source contract is retained deliberately until a source-contract consumer lands, because the two gates do not have the same rejection coverage (the task gate also refuses an empty `contract { }`). The seven-category reason-code vocabulary is specified prose with a mapping onto today's strings; no field carries it, so no consumer can filter on it. Code-level diagnostic golden tests remain future work, and historical reports retain their original provenance.

Observation scope/module/bounds substitution rejects; native provenance is declared trusted evidence and whole-program/source-model refinement remains open. Identity is provenance, not attestation: the compiler executable, its environment and the filesystem are trusted. Individual headers are not enumerated - the dependency closure is bound by effect through preprocessed_source_sha256 under -E -P, so a header edit that leaves the token stream unchanged does not change the identity. The declared driver is recorded, never checked for equivalence. The pinned Cycle19 compatibility adapter keeps CSourceInput::HistoricalStdin and its silent choice among 28 units with two or four compile configurations (G01 SS5); its four archived artifacts were not re-measured. Syntax and typed-AST phases still read preprocessed text from standard input, which is why __builtin_FILE/__builtin_FILE_NAME reject rather than being answered. P01-F2 is open: qcorec plugins verify/enable accept schema-valid, digest-intact edits to non-digest manifest declarations. P02 is not an OS sandbox: no namespace, cgroup, seccomp or capability-drop mechanism; no filesystem or network confinement (P03); RLIMIT_NPROC is per-UID and must not be presented as a per-execution child quota; non-Linux refuses rather than partially enforcing; the enforced profile is never selected by default.

counts_are_run_metadata: Every count in this record is run metadata about executed gates and manifests. It is not proof of specification coverage: projection coverage is not safety coverage, unknowns stay in the denominator, and a provisional Unsafe is never an upstream defect claim.

ct_evidence.note: ct_mapped/ct_unmapped above are inventory scalars, not coverage. T00 finding O7: the scalar treats a source-rejection case with zero native runs and a case with five reference executions plus five native runs as one identical unit of coverage. It is still binary. What changed at wave3-CT: 3 of 20 mapped cases (CT03, CT17, CT26) now carry GATED sanitized-native evidence, and 0 of 20 carry proof evidence. Counting rule for this block: a stage is `executed` for a case when the CT harness runs it on that case's own fixture; a stage a refused program never reaches is `not_applicable` (CT18 is refused during task lowering, so it never reaches the task ledger); observation_counts count invocations, not cases, and a case's accepted control is never counted as that case's own stage. The stage-derived rows live in the acceptance matrix.
